entries.title: House Oversight Panel Votes to Subpoena Pam Bondi as Part of Epstein Probe
entries.summary: The motion passed 24-19, with five Republicans in support.
entries.content:
The House Oversight Committee voted to subpoena Attorney General Pam Bondi on Wednesday over her role in releasing files related to the disgraced financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and his associates.

The resolution was introduced by Republican Rep. Nancy Mace, who had presented the subpoena to committee Chair Rep. James Comer earlier on Wednesday.

“AG Bondi claims the DOJ has released all of the Epstein files,” Mace posted on X. “The record is clear: they have not.”
entries.author: Amelia Benavides-Colón

entries.title: Senate Republicans Block Effort to Curb Trump’s War Powers on Iran
entries.summary: “I don't want today's vote to be interpreted that I don't think that Congress has a role,” Sen. Lisa Murkowski said after voting against the resolution. “Not by a long shot.”
entries.content:
Senate Republicans voted down a resolution Wednesday that would have limited President Donald Trump’s war powers on Iran, giving him the go-ahead to continue a deadly military campaign in the country without congressional approval.

The bipartisan measure, led by Sens. Tim Kaine and Rand Paul, failed 47 to 53. Other than Paul, all Republicans opposed it. Democratic Sen. John Fetterman also voted “no.”

The vote was Congress’ first major test of Trump’s legal power after he launched a military campaign against Iran over the weekend, which the Trump administration says was necessary to stop what it described as an imminent threat. The war powers resolution would have required the president to seek permission from Congress before continuing hostilities against Iran.
entries.author: Hamed Ahmadi
